values: A specific DNA allele was matched exactly, with full-length and sufficiently deep support.

Read input: every reference base has at least 3 aligned reads (default), with at least 2 uniquely supporting reads making up at least 10% of passing support. Gene FASTA input: one full-length sequence is sufficient.
A protein reference was matched exactly, but the underlying DNA allele is not proven.
100% amino-acid identity and 100% protein-reference coverage. Synonymous DNA differences cannot be detected from protein evidence.
A likely full-length allele match with enough support to be a candidate, but not exact.
At least 98% identity with full-length support; 3x depth for read inputs.
Strong match to a named allele, but not enough to call a specific allele.
Allele-like signal, but the exact or candidate call is still unresolved.
Yes (best protein-level allele signal, but not exact)
The gene family is clearly present, but the allele is not separated out.
Family-level support only; the exact allele cannot be distinguished.
The evidence looks mixed or patchy, as if more than one version is present.
Coverage breaks or borderline support make the call ambiguous.
Only part of the gene is supported, or the match is too different to trust.
Below the normal detection threshold, usually under 80% coverage and/or identity.
There was not enough evidence to call the gene present.
No call met the detection threshold.
Some of the genome is supported, but the combined evidence is incomplete or not strong enough for a near-complete call.
At least 20% of the combined genome is covered at 1x, but the near-complete coverage, identity, or read-support thresholds are not met.
The combined contigs cover most of one genome and pass the configured mapping-quality thresholds.
At least 80% of the combined genome length is covered at 3x by default, with the configured identity and read-support thresholds met.
The combined contigs provide complete high-confidence genome mapping; no gene or allele was resolved.
100% of the combined genome is covered at 1x, at least 95% is covered at 3x by default, and there are no internal coverage gaps beyond the configured tolerance.
Legacy per-reference whole-genome mapping status retained for compatibility.
A single reference sequence passed the configured mapping thresholds.
